scope: Separate synthetic compact visualization design. Not a measured textile or the paper supplementary model. Frozen original hierarchy fixture and optical data are unchanged.
conservative_clearance_interpretation: The global different-curve separation lower bound is 0.001 mm. minimum_tested_clearance_mm is the minimum only among retained candidates; do not relabel it as the global minimum. Omitted pairs have clearance greater than the 0.001 mm probe margin.
discrete_curvature_rule: At consecutive segment unit tangents t_i and lengths l_i, kappa_i = ||t_(i+1)-t_i|| / ((l_i+l_(i+1))/2). max_discrete_radius_curvature is a sampled diagnostic, not a continuum or global self-contact proof.
